# temps_project_identical_builds (Resource)

What Temps does when a build of the same source is already running or recent: build again, wait for it, or reuse its image. Destroying the resource leaves the setting as it is.

Import with `<project_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project_identical_builds" "web" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  mode       = "share"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) `parallel` builds again, `queue` waits for the running build, `share` reuses its image. One of `parallel`, `queue`, `share`.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `scope` (String) What makes two builds identical: the build inputs, or the source commit. One of `fingerprint`, `source`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>`.
- `reuse_window_seconds` (Number) How recent a build may be to be reused.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>
terraform import temps_project_identical_builds.web 8
```
